summary: HomesToLife Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, announcing the appointment of Zhengjie Jeff Chai as Chief Financial Officer, effective May 1, 2026. Mr. Chai had served as interim CFO since November 2025. His appointment follows a completed search. He will perform CFO duties via a services agreement between the company and HTL Furniture Inc., a related party. The filing includes the services agreement as an exhibit. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is involved. This is a routine management appointment, not a forced departure or abrupt change. What to watch: none — a routine corporate formality.
